The brief requires @n links, so the test needs the same @-stripping the nursing/law case already uses (or an update to compare question text only). All existing M questions keep their position, question text, right answer and difficulty, so lesson#index keys are unchanged; new M questions are appended after the old ones.

Sources used: OpenStax University Physics Vol 1 and 2 (2016), College Physics 2e (2022), Introductory Statistics 2e (2023, for the statistics lessons: hypothesis testing, significance, regression, residuals, confidence intervals, controls) and the AQA A-level Physics specification 7408 (sections checked in the downloaded PDF, sha256 32a556da85fa0928c3600f8178d1a18fe5156b2ea36d76b541df866451721e20, version 1.3). Every OpenStax section URL was fetched and its page title confirmed. Introductory Statistics 2e is outside the brief list of books; please confirm it is acceptable.

Some instrumentation lessons (lock-in amplifiers, signal-to-noise, data acquisition, sensors, cryogenics) cite the closest OpenStax sections (AC circuits, resonance, resistivity, heat capacity), which support only part of the content; a specialist instrumentation text would be a better source (needs source).
Lessons average about 4.5 KB, above the 2–3.5 KB aim, mainly because of the required five questions with explanations and the SA model answer.
